title: Source
description: A thing that exists in the world, and the citations into it, each a named anchor.

short-title.description: The abbreviation it is cited by.

type.description: What kind of source it is, an open word: parish-register, census, book.

author.description: Its author, for a book or a website.

publication.description: Where and when it was published, for a book or a website.

covers.description: What a register or an index records.

events.description: The events it records, in the words an event's type is written in.

date.description: The period over which it records them.

place.description: The place it records them for.

items.description: A repository's slug, or a mapping of the repository, the call number, the medium and a note.

call-number.description: The call number it is kept under there.

medium.description: The medium it is kept in, an open word: book, microfilm, electronic.

attributes.description: What else is said of it, the agency that kept it among them.

text.description: The source's own words where it is short enough to copy whole.

citations.description: The entries cited, each under its anchor.

event.description: The kind of entry it is, in the words an event's type is written in.

page.description: The locator somebody reads: c. 88r, n. 112.

date.description: The date the entry was written.

with.description: Who the entry names and as what.

images.description: The scans of it, each a path or a media entry whose region marks the entry on the page.

links.description: The image of this entry online.

attributes.description: What else is said of the entry.

note.description: What the researcher says of the entry as against what it says.

ids.description: What an export identified the entry by.

citation.description: An entry of the source: a pointer into it.

person.description: The person's record, or unknown for somebody the record says was there and does not name.

name.description: The name the record gives somebody who has no record.

role.description: Their part in it, an open word: godfather, godmother, witness, informant, officiant, groom, bride.

age.description: The age the record gives them.
